name: MediaMeta Sync
author: sudeepjha

sections.description:
MediaMeta Sync Product Image Metadata Importer allows store owners to bulk import image metadata for product images using a CSV file.

The plugin imports:

Image ALT Text
Image Title
Image Caption
Image Description

The plugin matches products using their SKU and updates the metadata of the associated product image.

Features

Bulk CSV import
Import image ALT text
Import image title
Import image caption
Import image description
Product SKU matching
Import progress indicator
Import log
AJAX-based importing
Easy-to-use admin interface
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
    1. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
    2. Ensure the required eCommerce plugin is installed and active.
    3. Navigate to Ecommerce Products Image Metadata Import.
    4. Upload your CSV file.
    5. Click Start Import.
sections.faq:
1. Which CSV columns are supported?

    The CSV should contain Product SKU together with the image metadata fields required by the plugin.

    2.Does it modify product information?

    No. The plugin only updates image metadata associated with the matched product image.

    1. Does it support large CSV files?

    Yes. The import runs using AJAX to process data in batches.
